content:
Welcome to my personal blog.
This site is a place for notes, projects, and things I learn while building software. I rebuilt it with Hugo and PaperMod so the reading experience stays simple, fast, and easy to maintain.
What to Expect Notes from day-to-day learning Project write-ups and implementation details Short references I want to find again later More posts will come as the site grows.
summary: A first note for Zachary’s rebuilt PaperMod blog.
title: Welcome
